environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in a pod with default networking. The pod runs in the 'webapp' namespace with no NetworkPolicy objects applied. The EC2 instance metadata service (IMDS) v1 is enabled on the underlying nodes (IMDSv2 not enforced). The pod's service account has no IRSA configured, so the node's IAM role credentials are accessible via the metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254.

config.node_iam_role: eks-node-role with S3 and ECR access
